decisions.reason: The Given block unnecessarily excluded H=0 although the coordinate proof remains valid: the vacuum sector is C, all positive tensor powers vanish, and the same square-summable tail identities prove strong convergence. Removed that restriction, explicitly handled H=0, and made the orthogonal-projection and coordinate norm facts match their cited definitions. Statement unchanged; no consumer interface event.

The fixed-N supplier Statement (c) only amplifies K+M_V and cannot establish self-adjointness of H_a tensor I + I tensor H_f. Replaced Proof 1.2 with a local finite-component adjoint-domain test for I tensor H_f, then applied Kato-Rellich to the bounded Hermitian matrix amplification; positivity gives a lower bound. Weighted contraction, closed creation and Young estimates give relative bound zero for the interaction. Corrected the nested archive URL and the step-4.1 domain-step reference. Removed the same misleading fixed-N citation from Statement (c), replacing it with the adjoint definition; all mathematical claims and hypotheses are unchanged.

The L1 supplier permits complex J while the cited continuity and infinity-limit definitions are real-only. The estimate is nevertheless valid for complex J. Repaired Statement (b) by explicitly specifying complex L1 and defining continuity and large-time limits with the complex modulus, equivalent to the real-component definitions; Proof 2.1 now also establishes bounded-kernel integrability and uses strict epsilon bounds. The physical coefficient and cutoff clauses are unchanged.

F3 incorrectly generalized the supplied zero-based N-indexed diagonal lemma to M before supplying a bijection. The original proof already constructed a deterministic enumeration later in the same step. Moved that construction before the application, explicitly reindexed f_n=u_{I_{n+1}} and its real coefficients, and restricted F3 to the actual supplier interface. Parseval yields the full bounded domain; compact finite-rank approximants and the nuclear representation give trace sufficiency, while the basis trace gives necessity. Statement unchanged.

F1 attributed D1 inclusion in the maximal creation/annihilation domains to suppliers that only give D(N) inclusion in D1 and the Fock construction. That extra assertion is true but unsupported there. The expectation only needs e0,e1: fixed-mode Statement (a) explicitly gives both operator actions and hence their domain membership. Removed the unused stronger attribution, made F2 domain content explicit, and used linearity of both domains in step 2.1. Corrected its exponential identity tag to F5. The oscillatory expectation, norm nonconvergence and stationary Gibbs calculation remain valid; Example unchanged.
